bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Lists the project's trace files; computes nothing.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which Sanger trace files does this project hold?

description: List the Sanger trace files in this project (.ab1 / .abi / .scf / .ztr) — the list a batch runs over. Wire its `names` into a trace reader's For-each so every read in the project is processed in one pipeline, instead of one node per read.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

name: list_traces

ids.description: their project file ids, in the same order (unambiguous where two names match)

names.description: the trace file names, in project order — the list to scatter a trace reader over
